title: Edit code containing regex or escapes with the Edit tool, not generated JS strings
body: Use the Edit tool for any replacement whose new text contains backslashes (regex classes like \s, \n literals, Windows paths). A replacement written as a JavaScript string in a `node -e` script or a heredoc drops one level of escaping silently, and CRLF files make exact-match replacements fail. Why: on 2026-09-22 heredoc-generated edits turned /\s+/ into /s+/ and broke two other regexes before a test caught one; the symptom is a regex that stops matching with no error.
not_derivable: Nothing in the repository shows an edit that lost its escapes; the failure is silent until a pattern stops matching.

evidence.summary: 2026-09-22: heredoc-generated edits corrupted three regexes in v1's retrieve.js (a file v2 removed).
